name: omniroute
description: Agent Skills and MCP tooling for OmniRoute — the unified AI router with 290+ providers, combo routing, compression and auto-fallback.

plugins.name: omniroute-api
plugins.description: 23 skills that teach Claude to drive a running OmniRoute instance over its OpenAI-compatible REST API: providers, models, combos & routing, API keys, budget, cache, compression, resilience, tunnels, webhooks, MCP, A2A and inference endpoints.

plugins.name: omniroute-cli
plugins.description: 22 skills that teach Claude to drive the `omniroute` command-line tool: serve, health, providers, keys, models, chat, routing, resilience, compression, contexts, cost, MCP, A2A, tunnels, backup, policy, batches, evals, plugins/memory, setup, skill collector and Codex CLI wiring.

plugins.name: omniroute-mcp
plugins.description: Connects Claude Code to the built-in OmniRoute MCP server (105 tools over stdio) for routing, cache, compression, memory, skills, pool, plugins and audit operations. Requires the `omniroute` CLI on PATH — ships disabled, enable it once OmniRoute is installed.
